summary: Bug-fix verification for iteration_5 web payment-proof upload issue. THE FIX WORKS. On the web build, the investor picked a PNG file via the DocumentPicker (invisible <input type=file>), the service correctly built a multipart FormData with the real File object, and the browser fired POST https://jbwerfqgqavaxdyjxfra.supabase.co/functions/v1/submit-payment-proof which returned HTTP 200 with the invite flipped to PROOF_SUBMITTED. The UI updated to 'PROOF SUBMITTED' + 'Proof submitted: test_proof.png' + 'Awaiting manager confirmation.' The regression test (LM Confirm payment) also still works end-to-end: POST /confirm-invite-payment returned 200 and the status flipped to CONFIRMED.

rca of the issue: N/A — bug from iteration_5 is FIXED. Verified end-to-end via UI + network interception. Fix summary: in /app/src/services/edgeFunctions.services.ts the function now detects web via `typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof document !== 'undefined'` and appends the real File/Blob (from the caller via `webFile` param, or via fetch(uri).blob() fallback) to FormData; on native it keeps the RN {uri,name,type} shape. Multipart Content-Type boundary was observed on the outgoing request and the edge function accepted it (200 OK).
